english.note: Use this when emphasizing an ongoing or repeatedly continuing action.
Use this when the emphasis is that the action keeps happening without stopping, rather than on its exact rate.
This is a more formal option for repeated or ongoing activity, especially in careful speech and writing.

examples.english: Lately, it has been raining ceaselessly, and the road keeps flooding.
examples.traditional: 呢排啲雨不斷咁落，條路成日水浸。
examples.jyutping: ni1 paai4 di1 jyu5 bat1 dyun6 gam3 lok6 tiu4 lou6 sing4 jat6 seoi2 zam3

examples.english: Lately it has been raining, and water has been steadily seeping into the house.
examples.traditional: 呢排落雨，不斷有水滲入屋企。
examples.jyutping: ni1 paai4 lok6 jyu5 bat1 dyun6 jau5 seoi2 sam3 jap6 uk1 kei2

examples.english: The pace of the project is continually accelerating.
examples.jyutping: gung1 cing4 zeon3 dou6 bat1 dyun6 gaa1 faai3
